treatment_setting_evidence.quote: This study is open to adults with newly diagnosed glioblastoma, a type of brain tumor.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Phase 0: Measured total concentration of BI 907828 (Brigimadlin) in brain tissue homogenate from noncontrast enhancing and contrast enhancing brain tumor regions

role_evidence.quote: The purpose of Part 2 is to find the highest dose of BI 907828 (Brigimadlin) that the participants can tolerate in combination with standard radiation therapy.

coder_notes: Registered Phase 1 with a Phase 0 (window-of-opportunity, single pre-surgical dose) part and a Phase Ia part with radiotherapy. TP53 wild type, unmethylated MGMT and IDH-wildtype are entry requirements for the Phase Ia part only, so coded as enrichment for that arm. Phase 0 part excludes known TP53-mutant tumours but testing is not mandatory. TP53 wild type matched to MDM2 inhibitor brigimadlin. Two sequential parts, neither a control: control_arm_from_other_arms = no.
